title: The Notice Percentage Carried by a Cancelled Event
content:
The notice percentage on a cancelled Private Event & Banquet Services booking is settled by the whole calendar days between the day written notice was given and the event date the cancellation entry records.

## The ladder, read in the order printed

1. Notice given at or beyond the free-cancellation days printed against the package carries no notice percentage at all.
2. Notice given inside the free-cancellation days but at or beyond thirty days before the event carries the ninety-to-thirty percentage printed against the package.
3. Notice given inside thirty days but at or beyond seven days before the event carries the thirty-to-seven percentage printed against the package.
4. Notice given inside seven days of the event carries the within-seven-days percentage printed against the package.

The free-cancellation days are read first, so on a package whose free window is wider than thirty days the second case covers only the notice later than that window.

## The figures each package prints

| Package | Free-cancellation days | Ninety to thirty days, per cent | Thirty to seven days, per cent | Inside seven days, per cent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 2 | 0 | 25 | 50 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 7 | 10 | 35 | 75 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 21 | 20 | 50 | 85 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 45 | 30 | 60 | 90 |
| Gala Reception Package | 90 | 40 | 70 | 100 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 120 | 50 | 75 | 100 |

## Boundary illustrations on the Seated Banquet Package, whose free window is 45 days

| Whole calendar days between notice and the event date | Notice percentage |
| --- | --- |
| 45 | 0, the free window being reached |
| 44 | 30 |
| 30 | 30 |
| 29 | 60 |
| 7 | 60 |
| 6 | 90 |

On the Gala Reception Package, whose free window of 90 days sits at the top of the ninety-to-thirty band, notice at 90 days carries no percentage and notice at 89 days carries 40 per cent.
